reply.summary: Seani is a veteran street fighter who turned a trained singing voice into a weapon, shattering windows and masonry with one held note. Seani stays inside a collapsing building ushering strangers out until the ceiling finally gives way.

feats.scene: Seani sends one held note through a brick wall and leaves it as loose rubble.
Seani shrugs off a beam dropping from a burning ceiling before the next one ends the fight.

reply.summary: Lltiltu is a fugitive brawler who can turn her body ghostly and let blows or walls pass straight through. Lltiltu fights with sharp hand-to-hand training and keeps one step ahead of the law.

feats.scene: Lltiltu slips through a vault door and drives a knee into the guard waiting behind it.
Lltiltu goes intangible as a speeding van passes through her without a scratch.

reply.summary: Tilnus is a widowed florist who gained a voice able to break brick and steel. Tilnus fights beside an archer ally against street crime and star-faring invaders alike, and knows every neighbour on the block.

feats.scene: Tilnus screams at a reinforced steel door until it buckles off its hinges.
Tilnus takes a thrown crate to the ribs and keeps singing.

reply.summary: Luvaco is a masked vigilante with a piercing scream who fought for the heroes until humanity turned on them. Luvaco dies in a crowded hall, outnumbered by an angry mob rather than any single foe.

feats.scene: Luvaco screams and every pane in the lobby blows outward at once.
Luvaco stays standing under a dozen clubs before the crowd drags her down.

reply.summary: Iaterci grew up among costumed veterans who raised her as family and drilled her until she could outfight most of them. Iaterci pairs a cracking sonic shout with detective work and a dry sense of humour.

feats.scene: Iaterci cracks a concrete pillar with a shout and ducks behind it.
Iaterci takes a sparring blow from her heaviest mentor and grins through it.

reply.summary: Tirerria is a deer who hurts herself on the sea cliffs of a hidden island once a century and always comes back whole. Tirerria is graceful, wary of strangers, and healed by a warm violet light each time.

feats.scene: Tirerria bounds off a cliff ledge and clips a fence rail into splinters.
Tirerria survives a long fall onto sea rocks and rises by dawn.

reply.summary: Anuna is a hot-rod mechanic who built a gang of dropouts around custom machines and a fast dragster. Anuna prefers oil and engines to patience, and the gang comes apart when teenagers play along then turn on him.

feats.scene: Anuna rams the dragster through a garage door at full throttle.
Anuna rolls clear of a wrecked chassis with only a split lip.

reply.summary: Taunesrno is a hired killer fused with machinery who steers a muscle car by thought and melds with it into a walking war machine. Taunesrno can turn hands into guns and fire bending bolts from the headlamps, but loses everything when the mech is wrecked.

feats.scene: Taunesrno bends a headlamp bolt around a corner and brings down a brick wall.
Taunesrno weathers a crushing blow inside the armoured shell until the shell finally folds.

reply.summary: Listicol is a warrior-engineer who thinks hard about machines and harder about men. Listicol is stronger than her sisters, lives for centuries, and takes apart captured automata to learn who is pulling the strings.

feats.scene: Listicol hurls a captured automaton across a workshop and pins it to the wall.
Listicol absorbs a trained spear thrust to the shoulder without stepping back.

reply.summary: Numirnsti is a lazy, theatrical god of grapes and stagecraft who prefers a good play to a good war. Numirnsti can fly, walk between worlds, and will never die, and uses charm and trickery before force.

feats.scene: Numirnsti tears open a vineyard hillside with one divine stamp and floods it with wine.
Numirnsti stands unmoved while a rival's thunderbolt splits the stage around him.

reply.summary: Eororeal is a rich heir who spends an inherited fortune filming traps for masked heroes. Eororeal has no powers, only a crew, a rebuilt cinema, and a belief that cruelty looks better on camera.

feats.scene: Eororeal triggers a rigged ceiling in the cinema aisle with a single switch.
Eororeal tumbles down the balcony stairs and stands up shouting for another take.

reply.summary: Visonrn is a chain-vaping agency chief whose skull-pale face and missing nose make him look like a walking warning. Visonrn runs a hunting operation against a fast runner and bargains with anyone who offers help.

feats.scene: Visonrn orders a van door slammed into a suspect and watches it fold.
Visonrn stays calm while a pistol round clips his coat.

reply.summary: Vaval is a stubborn newspaper columnist and widowed father who writes loud opinions and honestly believes each one. Vaval has no powers, but will put himself between a killer and a friend without hesitation.

feats.scene: Vaval swings a briefcase at a madman and knocks him off balance.
Vaval takes a hard shove into a desk and keeps arguing.

reply.summary: Corviar is a conman who faked his own death and disappeared into tunnels beneath the earth. Corviar returned with a gadget that scrambles minds across a whole city and a plan to rule through confusion.

feats.scene: Corviar switches on his scrambler and a whole avenue of drivers lose their heads at once.
Corviar takes a punch from a masked heroine and stays conscious long enough to run.

reply.summary: Naraurau is a bald, violet-skinned soldier in a ruthless future army, powered by a sun-like fire that he does not care to control. Naraurau flies into battle in formation and crushes outnumbered rivals.

feats.scene: Naraurau drops a column of solar fire onto a fortress and melts its outer wall.
Naraurau rides out a rival squad's volley without slowing his dive.

reply.summary: Cinna is a cheerful young hero from a far-future club of gifted teens, always eager to join a mission. Cinna helps round up space thieves alongside a surprise guest from the past.

feats.scene: Cinna pins two smugglers to a cargo bay wall with a bright burst.
Cinna walks off a stun bolt and keeps chasing the getaway ship.

reply.summary: Saceo is a proud politician of a xenophobic planet who treats every outsider as pollution. Saceo breaks his son's telescope lenses and orders a stranded visitor killed, and the harm done to his family outlasts him.

feats.scene: Saceo smashes a telescope against the cave floor in a cold rage.
Saceo shrugs off a tumble down a stone staircase and keeps lecturing.

reply.summary: Rustau is a masked schemer who stirs up floods, quakes and fires, then loots whatever the panic leaves unguarded. Rustau is blond, secretive, and always has one more catastrophe waiting.

feats.scene: Rustau cracks a hillside dam and drowns a harbour district under brown water.
Rustau rides out a toppling crane with a bruised shoulder.

reply.summary: Reoau is a winged horse who carried one rider and then another into battle. Reoau tucks her wings away on the ground, vanishes and reappears in a flash, and runs faster than any normal steed.

feats.scene: Reoau lands hooves-first on a barricade and flattens it.
Reoau streaks across a canyon faster than the echo of her own whinny.

reply.summary: Cesarnu is a swallowed goddess released from a titan's gut and put to work in a new dark pantheon. Cesarnu hands out cruel gifts, bending feelings and bestowing heartbreak, and keeps her contempt for mortals.

feats.scene: Cesarnu lays a curse on a clay effigy and a whole harbour town turns on itself.
Cesarnu endures the bellies of titans and walks out unharmed.

reply.summary: Serillla is a digital avatar piloted by a lonely teenager, used to trap schoolmates in a simulation that feeds on their fears. Serillla is fast online, helpless offline, and undone by a burst that kills the signal.

feats.scene: Serillla floods a gamer's visor with static until he collapses on the couch.
Serillla survives repeated lag spikes but flickers out when the pulse lands.

reply.summary: Sirnlan is a shadowy criminal from a far-future age, known only by a buzzing code name that hints at rattling, shaking attacks. Sirnlan leaves little behind except hair-trigger rumours and shaken locks.

feats.scene: Sirnlan shakes a vault until its bolts rattle loose and drop to the floor.
Sirnlan blurs out of a security sweep before the alarm finishes ringing.

reply.summary: Neoenust is a grey-haired gentleman of impeccable manners, quietly working for himself in the shadows. Neoenust has no known powers, only polish, an umbrella, and a reputation that nobody can quite confirm.

feats.scene: Neoenust raps an umbrella across a pickpocket's wrist.
Neoenust straightens his tie after being shouldered into a lamppost.

reply.summary: Talen is a lab-grown copy of a super-strong alien heroine, built as a weapon for a scheming financier. Talen tries to claim the original's life as her own and fights with borrowed power and bitter pride.

feats.scene: Talen lifts a frozen ridge and slams it down on a mining camp.
Talen takes a falling research tower on her back and shoves it aside.

reply.summary: Niianau is a silent bald enforcer whose body leaks glowing smoke from his mouth. Niianau guards a desert drug operation and can spit a radioactive shove that flattens a person.

feats.scene: Niianau spits an irradiated blast that hurls a pickup truck across the sand.
Niianau shrugs off a point-blank shotgun burst and keeps guarding the gate.

reply.summary: Riall is a vast blue spirit that spent ages sealed in a bottle and now answers wishes with literal, deadly results. Riall flies, takes any shape, and gets uneasy only when a command seems too harsh.

feats.scene: Riall swoops over a palace and lays its roof in the courtyard.
Riall shrugs off a witch's fire spell like heat from a lantern.

reply.summary: Anuaul is a living man reduced to numbers and stored in a magnetic flask, forced to work for a terror cell. Anuaul slides through walls, wrecks machines, and strangles guards that cannot touch him back.

feats.scene: Anuaul reaches through a steel locker and crushes the radio behind it.
Anuaul lets a hail of rifle fire pass through his shoulders unharmed.

reply.summary: Serconi is a wish-granting spirit born four millennia ago, rare among her kind, bound to a ring and passed between masters. Serconi dislikes the harm her wishes do and longs for freedom from her eldest sibling.

feats.scene: Serconi grants a wish and a whole warehouse of stone rises into a sculpted tower.
Serconi endures an ancient curse for centuries without ageing a day.

reply.summary: Lonutau is a big red gorilla who lives in the jungle and stays loyal to a human friend. Lonutau is strong, careful, and carries a hidden sadness.

feats.scene: Lonutau snaps a thick branch and swings it into a charging poacher.
Lonutau takes a hunter's slug on the shoulder and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Corvalse is a living mathematical equation given a ring of will, able to enter minds and rub them out. Corvalse draws power from a battery of light, and its work remains a quarrelsome subject among its allies.

feats.scene: Corvalse fires a bolt from its ring that cracks open a rocky moonlet.
Corvalse raises a glowing shield against a falling asteroid and holds it.

reply.summary: Nenmari is a bald conqueror from a peaceful distant age who bent magnetic technology toward domination. Nenmari wrecks a time machine and tries to rule the past, and only the earth beneath his feet keeps him strong.

feats.scene: Nenmari drags a freight train off its track with a pulse of magnetism.
Nenmari shrugs off an unsteady scientist's wrench but falters once he is lifted off the ground.

reply.summary: Viser is a mysterious gang ally in a soldier's coat, healed by alien medicine into a flying powerhouse. Viser comes and goes as he likes, shines with light, and adapts quickly to each new hazard.

feats.scene: Viser swoops under a bridge and tears a parked truck apart in one pass.
Viser takes a rooftop collapse across his shoulders and stands up shining.
Viser darts the length of the span before its lamps flicker on.

reply.summary: Vaiutel is a robot soldier ordered to wipe out a hidden world, who later chose to bury and protect the survivors. Vaiutel adopts a lone orphan as family and gives up everything to end the machine that created him.

feats.scene: Vaiutel overloads a planetary engine and the world splits apart in white fire.
Vaiutel carries a collapsed tunnel's weight on steel shoulders while the orphan crawls clear.

reply.summary: Rosta is a white-haired physician from the north who treats teenagers with unusual injuries. Rosta has no powers, only steady hands and years of practice.

feats.scene: Rosta pins a struggling patient to the table and stitches the wound shut.
Rosta stays at the bedside through a night of shouting and a broken lamp.

reply.summary: Eovaltiu is a masked small-time crook who runs a modest gang and now lives quietly in a desert resort town. Eovaltiu sold out a disguised hero once, and still has enough hired muscle to make trouble.

feats.scene: Eovaltiu orders his crew to kick in a casino back door.
Eovaltiu takes a bruising punch and laughs it off in front of his men.

reply.summary: Raseron is a bald scientist who does odd experiments in a basement lab, a mad inventor in a long line of them. Raseron cares for the work more than for any person.

feats.scene: Raseron wires a coil to a steel table and sends a crackling arc into an intruder.
Raseron is thrown across the lab by his own surge and sits up laughing.

reply.summary: Amvast is a masked scientist-villain who builds strange devices to annoy a flying hero in red. Amvast hides his identity, wears dark hair slicked back, and has a flair for the dramatic.

feats.scene: Amvast fires a lab-built cannon that blasts a hole in a warehouse wall.
Amvast shakes off a thrown crate and vaults a workbench.

reply.summary: Serleotau is a red-haired doctor who moonlights as a monstrous-looking helper to outcasts like himself. Serleotau stitches wounds in secret and answers calls from the strange and the shunned.

feats.scene: Serleotau sets a broken arm with a sharp twist and a murmured apology.
Serleotau stumbles out of a mob scuffle with a torn coat and a steady grin.

reply.summary: Reoser is a plant-wise earth shaman, the newest in an unbroken line of healers whose power is the sum of all those before. Reoser dreams of a world without laws and spreads visions through a city's air before missiles ends it.

feats.scene: Reoser calls a forest through a street and wraps a convoy in roots.
Reoser stands firm against an acid warhead before the second missile lands.

reply.summary: Eoveora is a black-haired crook who floods towns on purpose so his gang can empty the banks. Eoveora ends up in an island prison whose cell window shows only the sea he used.

feats.scene: Eoveora opens a river gate and a whole village is under water by noon.
Eoveora gets knocked flat by a wave of his own making and spits seawater.

reply.summary: Niuva is a clever scientist dog who grew up after a world-wide collapse among talking beasts. Niuva quietly studies ways to help primitive humans rebuild, and keeps the work hidden from the cats who rule.

feats.scene: Niuva mixes two tinctures and sprays a startled guard with a fast-acting sleep mist.
Niuva survives a tumble down a ruined stairwell with only a bruised paw.

reply.summary: Tirnaan is a dog-man with white fur, one of many bred by a secret programme and living on a remote island. Tirnaan is a researcher who suspects the island's culture began with a human society.

feats.scene: Tirnaan hurls a stack of notebooks at a rude colleague.
Tirnaan stays on his feet when a crate falls across his back.

reply.summary: Siilete is a white-haired army scientist who spent a career building a machine meant to end war by putting armies to sleep. Siilete's invention is stolen by an impostor, and the rays never injure anyone except those who fall.

feats.scene: Siilete powers up the sleeping-ray cabinet and a parade ground of soldiers slump to the mud.
Siilete stays on his feet in the cabinet's cloud of sparks.

reply.summary: Llrninu is a bald schemer who calls himself the cleverest man alive and plagues a pair of flying hero partners. Llrninu has no powers and relies on gadgets, patter and a good head start.

feats.scene: Llrninu triggers a trapdoor and drops two guards into the cellar.
Llrninu hits the floor hard after a tackle and scrambles out the window.

reply.summary: Onesirsti is a grey-haired criminal scientist who builds odd vehicles and bullies unwilling pilots into stealing statues. Onesirsti bounces back from capture, swears revenge on an archer hero, and teams up with a mind-wiping crook.

feats.scene: Onesirsti drives the oddball contraption through a museum wall.
Onesirsti bounces off the dash in a crash and gets up sneering.

reply.summary: Cerleo is a sinister physician known by a grim title, who prowls the pages of an old wartime flying-aces series. Cerleo is little documented, but menaces pilots with a taste for the macabre.

feats.scene: Cerleo smashes a laboratory window and flees across the rooftops.
Cerleo shakes off a fall from a hangar ladder with a limp.

reply.summary: Arllunu is a bald crackpot scientist who goes by a fate-themed alias and picks fights with a pair of flying young heroes. Arllunu loses every round, but his taunts get sharper each time.

feats.scene: Arllunu sets off a flash charge under a lab bench and shatters his own beakers.
Arllunu is flung into a shelf of chemicals and crawls out spluttering.

reply.summary: Liiar is a former mind-analyst turned boastful evil genius who is sure everyone is beneath him. Liiar disguises himself as an old woman, lures heroes into a sewer lab, and escapes by rocket chair when his machine fails.

feats.scene: Liiar turns on a transfer rig and the sewer ceiling shakes.
Liiar rides his chair out of a collapsing tunnel in a cloud of soot.

reply.summary: Allira is a scaly-faced thief who herds prehistoric beasts into banks and monuments. Allira is stopped by a stretchy hero, and never learns that dinosaurs make poor getaway drivers.

feats.scene: Allira sets a stampeding herd on a vault wall and drops it into the street.
Allira tumbles from a saddle and brushes off the dust.

reply.summary: Sianuse is a black-haired villain with a mournful nickname, scarcely documented, who appears in an old patriotic series. Sianuse frightens rather than fights, and leaves the hero guessing at his plans.

feats.scene: Sianuse topples a church bell tower and escapes in the noise.
Sianuse stays upright through a chase and a rooftop fall.
